entries.7911b7e4a7ef45eb: The reportable segment is a single segment: manufacture and sale of temporary construction materials and logistics equipment. It manufactures, sells and rents temporary construction materials (system scaffolding, etc.) and performs temporary construction work, and manufactures and sells logistics equipment (pallets, etc.). Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥20,138 million. The Group consists of the company and eight consolidated subsidiaries; Yagumi Co., Ltd., Kaizu Construction Co., Ltd. and others handle scaffolding work and civil engineering and building construction. The head office is in Kaizu, Gifu Prefecture.
